plain.li: [gate] Ready to go when everyone else is.
[gate] Is everyone here yet?
[gate] The others will be along any moment.
[gate] I'm as ready as I'll ever be.
[gate] Not long now.
[wait] We'll give them another hour.
[wait] No point leaving anyone behind if we can help it.
[wait] Another hour, then we see where things stand.
[leave] Right, let's be off.
[leave] Keep the fires lit for us.
[leave] We'll be back before you miss us.
[leave] The road's waiting.
[seeoff] Safe roads, all of you.
[seeoff] Come back in one piece.
[seeoff] Bring us back some good news.
[seeoff] Watch the weather out there.
[seeoff] We'll keep things running while you're gone.
[foundleave] Let's go and make a home of it.
[foundleave] Last look back, then the road.
[foundleave] Somewhere out there is our new hearth.
[foundseeoff] Send word when the first roof is up.
[foundseeoff] We'll miss you at supper.
[foundseeoff] Make it a good place.

warm.li: [seeoff] Look after each other out there.
[leave] Take care of the place while we're away.

gloomy.li: [leave] I hope the road is kinder than the last one.

cold.li: [seeoff] Return when the work is done.
